items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-11-17
items.q: I just remember seeing Frankie Duesen a couple of times. Because he's going on jobs and I'd see him. Tall fella, could have, you know, I knew him.

ctx.x: Yeah, and the numbers, you know. I hear a big gambler. What's all back is that? He was a big gambler in there. I think he's still. See, a lot of people got me wrong. Well, they think this is my home.

Well, see, I didn't come to New Orleans, and I was, I went in the army, come out the army and come to New Orleans, that's it. You used to live in the nation then? That's my home, Recafo. Well, that's a home, where they're like, by the day. See, I was born in the by the day, I was raised there. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Now, I never seen Buddy Bordell. Never seen him. And I just remember…
Ask him about some of the good mandolin players here.
